items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1962-02-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Not Larchens? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, as far as I know that place, I can't call the name.

ctx.x: Yeah, Chris Kelly, Buddy Petit, Rene, now he would have made a nice trumpet player that boy, if he hadn't got the proper schooling, you know. He was better than Buddy Petit. Rene, he was very good. But he was too much of a musician, but he could play the horn nice, you know, like Louis, you know. Had a nice time? Yeah, a nice, very nice time. What kind of jobs did he play? Nothing but dances, you know, like we played. Maybe one of the little nightclubs, you know. During the war he played down at the, what's the…
Not Larchens? No, no. Oh, no, that's on Almanaster. I can't think of that one.
Yeah, as far as I know that place, I can't call the name.
